description: This file defines the 'Credit' controller class for the OpenCart admin extension, specifically under the 'Total' category. It handles the display and saving of the total credit feature in the admin panel, including rendering the interface and processing configuration updates.

classes.name: Credit
classes.description: Controller class for managing the total credit extension in OpenCart admin panel. It provides methods for rendering the configuration page and saving settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the credit total configuration page in the admin panel, initializing the language, breadcrumb navigation, and loading required views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of configuration settings for the total credit extension, including permission check, updating settings, and returning JSON response.
